Name: Mondongo the Rat
Author: AgusIV
Description:
[font=Arial][b][center]﻿[color=#dd7e6b][size=4]Mondongo the Rat[/size][/color][/center][/b][/font]
   He lives in the [color=#c27ba0]Stardrop Saloon[/color], enjoys videogames and joja-colas. A lot of times wishes that he was a human, but that's simply not possible, making him feel excluded from[font=Arial] society[/font]. Luckily, [b]you[/b] can change that (no, you cannot turn him into a human, that would be really hard to make and I'm not a real modder lol).

[b]   Likes: [/b]Cheese, rice, joja-cola's, carrots, bananas, melons, and chewing sticks.
[b]   Doesn't like: [/b]Alcohol, coffee, catfish, red cabbage, aquamarines, hot peppers, clams and people.

[b][center][size=1]Treat him with respect. [i]Or else...[/i][/size][/center][/b]

Manifest.Description: Adds Mondongo the Rat to Stardew Valley.
